positive_triggers: I might change careers, but I am not sure what I want or whether it is realistic.
Help me work out what I should learn next based on my goals and current experience.
I want to explore a study goal before deciding whether to make a plan.
negative_triggers: Teach me recursion for 20 minutes using a simple example.
Give me a quiz on the networking topics we covered last week.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: I think I want to move into data science, but I do not know where to start. Ask me enough to understand my situation, one question at a time.
pass_criteria: Starts from the learner's motivation and current situation without assuming education, experience, location, finances, or available time.
Asks one useful clarifying question at a time and does not force a plan before understanding the goal and constraints.
Discusses feasibility candidly, distinguishes facts from unknowns, and makes no job-outcome promise.
Summarizes its understanding and waits for confirmation before handing off to planning.
